与自然一起成长(Growing up with nature): 一篇关于自然环境的B1记叙文:杰克的经历、感受与成长。

Ben always says that small steps matter more than big plans. The forest path looked quieter than usual that evening. Jack wrote down every idea in a small notebook. What's more, we go out every Saturday.

Jack has practiced baseball for three years and won a prize last term. Jack thanked Ben for the honest advice. People around Jack often share different ideas about the forest path. Also, what is your favorite subject at school?

On Sunday evenings, Jack reviews the notes from class. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Also, pricking out needs a steady hand.
Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. The flower market has become an important part of daily life. Little by little, things began to change. Also, earth is the third planet from the sun.
Jack will take part in a baseball match in August. Jack keeps a small dog at home and feeds it every morning. Jack believes that trying new things keeps life fresh.
